The native iOS keyboard has more gestures than you may think, where keys can be pressed, released, and long pressed, space can be dragged to move the cursor, shift can be double tapped, etc.
KeyboardKit lets you handle complex gestures with very little code and has a
protocol with handler types like
, which lets you drag the spacebar to move the input cursor.
You can use the
view modifier to customize keyboard gestures, for instance the double-tap timeout and long press delay, and
to apply custom keyboard gesture to any view.
